ui.heroEyebrow.context: Hero: small eyebrow line above the H1 (2–4 words; uppercased by CSS — do not write it in capitals).

ui.title.context: Page H1 and the first part of the browser-tab <title> («<title> – Al-Ahsa»). The header/footer nav label of this page is the published nav.fruits = «Oasenfrüchte» (not editable here); the H1 may differ, as it does in English («Oasis Fruits» vs «Seasonal Fruits of Al-Ahsa»).

ui.heroSum.en: In the world’s largest oasis, the seasons take turns over the groves, offering visitors a new fruit and flavour with each one — from golden summer rutab to winter kanar and the oasis’s famous lime.
ui.heroSum.ar: في أكبر واحة في العالم، تتعاقب المواسم على البساتين فتهدي زائرها في كل فصل ثمرةً ومذاقاً: من رطب الصيف الذهبي إلى كنار الشتاء ولومي الواحة الشهير.
ui.heroSum.context: Hero lead paragraph under the H1 (≈62ch column). FIRST OCCURRENCE IN THE BODY of «rutab», «kanar» and the Hasawi lime on the whole page — their one gloss per page goes HERE (rule 7), and the fruit cards in batches 2–3 will not gloss them again. Carries the owner-fixed claim «the world’s largest oasis» (C15: exactly «die größte Oase der Welt» — never «Palmenoase», never «natürliche»).

ui.stat1n.context: Big number in a stat tile (large display type, very short). Same fact as the source: 2.5 million. German number style.

ui.stat2n.context: Big number in the second stat tile. Same fact: 400 thousand. German number style, consistent with stat 1.

ui.statsSrc.en: Per the Guinness World Records listing (October 2020) and Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture statistics.
ui.statsSrc.ar: وفق تسجيل موسوعة غينيس للأرقام القياسية (أكتوبر 2020م) وإحصاءات وزارة البيئة والمياه والزراعة.
ui.statsSrc.context: Small source note under the two stat tiles. Name the institutions as they are named in the glossary/official German usage; keep «October 2020».

ui.rare.context: Small tag next to one fruit name (the Suwari pomegranate) — owner’s wording «شبه منقرض». Short tag.

ui.emptyMsg.en: No fruits recorded for this season yet.

ui.countPrefix.context: Screen-reader status after filtering: this prefix is followed directly by a number («Fruits shown: 7»). Keep the trailing colon + space.

ui.methodH.en: About the accuracy of this page
ui.methodH.context: H2 of the note box at the bottom of the page.

ui.methodP1.en: This page draws on trusted official and agricultural sources, and we take care to verify every fact before publishing it.
ui.methodP1.ar: اعتمدنا في هذه الصفحة على مصادر رسمية وزراعية موثوقة، وحرصنا على التحقّق من كل معلومة قبل نشرها.
ui.methodP1.context: First paragraph of the note box.

ui.methodP2.en: Ripening dates shift slightly from season to season with the weather; this information was reviewed in {reviewed}.
ui.methodP2.ar: تختلف مواعيد النضج قليلاً من موسم لآخر بحسب الأحوال الجوية؛ رُوجعت هذه المعلومات في {reviewed}.
ui.methodP2.context: Second paragraph of the note box. {reviewed} is a placeholder replaced at build time by the German month and year («Juli 2026») — keep «{reviewed}» literally, exactly once.

ui.description.en: A season-by-season tour of Al-Ahsa Oasis fruits: dates and rutab, Hasawi lime, yellow melon, figs, kanar and more — verified from official sources.
ui.description.ar: جولة على ثمار واحة الأحساء بمواسمها: التمور والرطب، اللومي الأحسائي، البطيخ الأصفر، التين، الكنار وغيرها — بمعلومات موثقة من مصادر رسمية.
ui.description.context: SEO meta description (search-result snippet). German target ≤ 160 characters. The fruit names must match the German card names that batches 2–3 will use — keep them generic here (dates and rutab, Hasawi lime, yellow melon, figs, kanar) and consistent with the glossary.
